Okay, take us through it properly.

Bounded iteration repeats a fixed number of times using a FOR loop. Unbounded iteration repeats while (or until) a condition holds: a WHILE loop tests its condition before each repetition, so it can run zero times; REPEAT…UNTIL tests at the end, so it always runs at least once.
